title: The Cassette That Played Imran's Voice | ECHO//30 Ep. 3
description:
Before sunset can erase another memory, Tara broadcasts ten seconds of her missing brother's voice. Navapur answers—and hundreds of forgotten people begin speaking back.

Kavi and Tara split over Byte's secrets, Null reveals what the city buried, and Dr. Rhea Rao proves she knows exactly how to stop Project ECHO.
